description: Source code implementing memory allocation functions for audio processing, including initialization, adding members, and retrieving total memory size.

methods.name: InstAlloc_Init
methods.description: Initializes an INST_ALLOC instance with a starting address, setting total size and next member pointer.

methods.name: InstAlloc_AddMember
methods.description: Allocates space for a new member in the instance memory, ensuring 32-bit alignment, and returns its address.

methods.name: InstAlloc_GetTotal
methods.description: Returns the total allocated memory size for an INST_ALLOC instance.

methods.name: InstAlloc_InitAll
methods.description: Initializes multiple INST_ALLOC instances based on memory regions from a memory table.

methods.name: InstAlloc_InitAll_NULL
methods.description: Initializes multiple INST_ALLOC instances with size 3 and null next member pointers.

methods.name: InstAlloc_AddMemberAll
methods.description: Adds members to multiple INST_ALLOC instances and updates a memory table with their sizes and types.

methods.name: InstAlloc_AddMemberAllRet
methods.description: Adds members to multiple INST_ALLOC instances, stores their addresses in a pointer array, and returns the first member address.
